Our valued client – Itero, based in Perth WA is seeking highly experienced MECHANICAL FITTERS to join their dedicated team of professionals. The ideal candidate must be reliable, results-driven, self-motivated, and committed to positively contribute to the team environment.

Itero is Australia’s leading expert in projects complicated by height and specialists in complex asset remediation and maintenance solutions operating across multiple sectors.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The Mechanical Fitter is responsible for delivering safe, high-quality mechanical maintenance, shutdown, project and installation services for Itero Australia's clients across mining, industrial, commercial and infrastructure sectors. The role is based on client sites and supports Itero's commitment to Zero Harm, quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Key Responsibilities
Carry out planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance
Install, overhaul and commission pumps, gearboxes, conveyors, crushers, valves, pipework and rotating equipment
Complete precision alignment, bearing replacement and mechanical fault finding
Read and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs and OEM manuals
Assist with shutdowns, construction and capital projects
Complete job documentation, maintenance reports and QA records
Provide outstanding client service and represent Itero professionally
Maintain tools, vehicles and company equipment
Assist Rope Access crews where required
Travel to metropolitan, regional and FIFO sites as required

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
Work in accordance with Itero Australia's Integrated Management System
Comply with WHS legislation, client requirements and company procedures
Complete Take 5s, SWMS, JHAs, permits and isolations before commencing work
Report hazards, incidents and near misses immediately
Participate in toolbox meetings and continuous improvement initiatives
Promote Itero's Zero Harm culture
Qualifications & Licences

Mandatory
Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade (or equivalent)
IRATA Rope Access Level 2/3
Working at Heights
Confined Space Entry
Gas Test Atmospheres
Current Australian Driver's Licence
Construction White Card
Ability to pass medical and drug & alcohol screening

Preferred
High Risk Work Licence (Forklift, EWP, Rigging or Dogging)
First Aid
National Police Clearance (where required by clients)

Skills & Experience
Minimum 3 years’ experience
Experience within mining, industrial maintenance, oil & gas or manufacturing
Strong knowledge of rotating equipment and mechanical systems
Competent with precision measuring equipment and laser alignment
Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Excellent communication and commitment to quality

Core Values
Safety First
Integrity
Teamwork
Quality
Continuous Improvement
Customer Focus

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

About Us

Advanced Group Australia is a leading provider of skilled labour solutions across construction, civil, and industrial sectors. With a strong presence in New South Wales and an ongoing commitment to safety, quality, and workforce development, we work with top-tier clients on major infrastructure and building projects. Our team takes pride in delivering reliable, qualified personnel who keep projects moving and completed to the highest standards.

We are currently seeking an experienced and reliable Sheet Metal Worker to join our growing team.

Role

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, and repairing sheet metal products and structures. This includes working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron for applications in construction, HVAC, and industrial installations. You will collaborate with supervisors, tradespeople, and site managers to deliver precise and safe workmanship that aligns with project specifications.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications for fabrication and installation.
- Measure, cut, bend, and shape sheet metal using hand tools, machines, and cutting equipment.
- Assemble and join sheet metal components using welding, riveting, and fastening techniques.
- Install sheet metal products, such as ductwork, roofing, flashing, panels, and frameworks on construction sites.
- Perform modifications or repairs on existing installations, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards.
- Operate and maintain workshop machinery and tools with care and attention to safety protocols.
- Conduct inspections and quality checks on finished products or installations.
- Comply with all site safety requirements and Advanced Group’s work health and safety (WHS) procedures.

Skills & Qualifications
- AQF Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (Sheet Metal Working) or similar (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in sheet metal fabrication, installation, or maintenance.
- Proficiency in working with a range of sheet metal tools and machinery.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.
- White Card (Construction Induction).
- Valid driver’s licence and reliable transport.

Australian citizens and permanent residents encouraged to apply.

Salary & Location
Salary: $78,000 – $80,000 per annum plus superannuation (commensurate with experience).
Location: Advanced Group Australia, Guildford NSW 2161.

We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Painter Blasters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Painter Blaster, you will be responsible for preparing, blasting, coating, and painting steel structures, mining equipment, industrial machinery, and fabricated components. You will ensure all surface preparation and protective coating work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project specifications, Australian Standards, and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret work instructions, technical drawings, and coating specifications.

•	Mix paints and coatings in accordance with manufacturer specifications and project requirements.
•	Inspect prepared surfaces and completed coatings to ensure compliance with quality standards and required film thickness.
•	Perform touch-up work, maintenance painting, and coating repairs on mining and industrial equipment.
•	Safely operate blasting equipment, spray-painting equipment, compressors, and other associated tools.
•	Conduct routine maintenance and cleaning of painting and blasting equipment.
•	Maintain accurate records of completed work, coating materials used, and quality inspections.

•	Assist with shutdown, maintenance, fabrication, and construction projects as required.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Painter Blaster or in a similar industrial coatings role.
•	Experience in abrasive blasting, surface preparation, and industrial protective coatings.
•	Knowledge of industrial paint systems, coating application techniques, and quality inspection procedures.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and coating specifications.
•	Experience working in mining, oil and gas, construction, or heavy industrial environments is highly regarded.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality workmanship, and environmental compliance.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.

•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Drive Production Excellence in a Growing Manufacturing Business 
 Supportive Team | Ownership & Autonomy | Real Career Growth 
 Are you an experienced Production Planner who thrives on keeping manufacturing operations running efficiently? Do you enjoy balancing customer expectations, production capacity, and operational priorities to deliver exceptional outcomes? 
 Our client is a well-established and highly respected Australian manufacturer of premium aluminium windows and doors, supplying customised solutions to both residential and commercial construction projects. 
 This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of production planning within a growing business where your expertise will directly influence customer satisfaction, operational performance, and on-time delivery. Working closely with the Operations Manager, production team, customers, and installation contractors, you'll play a critical role in ensuring projects move seamlessly from order through to installation. 
 If you're proactive, highly organised, and enjoy solving problems in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you. 
 What's on Offer 
 
 Join a well-established Australian manufacturing business with an excellent industry reputation. 
 Take ownership of the production planning function and make a genuine impact. 
 Supportive leadership team that values collaboration and continuous improvement. 
 Opportunity to influence operational performance and process improvements. 
 Stable, long-term career opportunity with room for professional growth. 
 Work in a dynamic and fast-paced manufacturing environment where no two days are the same. 
 
 About the Role 
 As the Production Planner, you will be responsible for coordinating production schedules, monitoring workflow, and ensuring manufacturing activities align with customer requirements, factory capacity, and delivery commitments. 
 You will act as the central point of communication between customers, production teams, subcontractors, and management, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and to the highest standard. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Production Planning & Scheduling 
 
 Develop and maintain the master production schedule. 
 Coordinate production activities based on customer demand, labour availability, material supply, and manufacturing capacity. 
 Prioritise workloads to maximise efficiency and ensure on-time delivery. 
 
 Production Coordination & Delivery

 Customer & Stakeholder Communication

 Provide accurate updates regarding production progress, lead times, and delivery schedules. 
 Build strong working relationships across internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Performance Monitoring 
 
 Monitor key operational KPIs including DIFOT, production capacity, and workflow efficiency. 
 Identify potential bottlenecks, production risks, and scheduling constraints. 
 Implement practical solutions to minimise delays and maximise productivity. 
 
 Continuous Improvement 
 
 Identify opportunities to improve production planning processes and workflow efficiency. 
 Support operational initiatives that enhance productivity, communication, and customer outcomes. 
 Provide additional operational coordination and administrative support as required. 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will bring: 
 
 Previous experience in Production Planning, Scheduling, Manufacturing Coordination, or a similar role. 
 Experience working within a made-to-order manufacturing environment. 
 Strong understanding of aluminium fabrication, manufacturing processes, or related production environments. 
 Experience using  Alspec V6  is essential. 
 Experience with ERP/MRP systems. 
 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills will be highly regarded. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Excellent organisational and time management abilities. 
 Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 A proactive, hands-on approach with a continuous improvement mindset. 
 Previous leadership or supervisory experience will be viewed favourably. 
 
 Why Apply? 
 This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business that genuinely values quality, teamwork, and operational excellence. You'll have the autonomy to influence production outcomes, work alongside experienced professionals, and contribute to the continued growth and success of a respected Australian manufacturer.

About the Company

AWM OILS PTY LTD Service Stations, a proudly Australian family-owned business operating across Victoria for more than 2 years. The site offers quality fuel, convenience shopping, barista-made coffee, and freshly prepared food. The company is recognised for its friendly customer service, honest fuel pricing, and modern convenience experience. AWM continues to expand its presence by combining fuel services with supermarkets, cafés, and takeaway options to provide customers with a one-stop destination for everyday needs and travel convenience.

About the role
We are seeking an experienced Retail Manager to take full operational ownership of our retail store, team, and supporting operations. This is a genuine management role suited to someone who wants to lead, build, and be accountable for outcomes.

Job Description

Position: Retail Manager

Location of Work: 191-201 High Street, Nagambie, Vic-3608

Employment Type: Permanent, Full time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

• Oversee the daily operations of the fuel service station, convenience store, and food service areas to ensure efficient business performance and high customer service standards.

• Monitor fuel, grocery, food, and retail stock levels, coordinate ordering activities, and maintain appropriate inventory control procedures to minimise shortages and wastage.

• Supervise, train, and support retail staff, including preparing work rosters, allocating duties, monitoring performance, and ensuring compliance with workplace policies and procedures.

• Develop and implement sales, merchandising, and promotional strategies to maximise revenue, improve customer engagement, and increase store profitability.

• Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety regulations, food safety standards, fuel handling procedures, and company operational policies.

• Monitor daily financial transactions, reconcile cash registers, prepare sales reports, and assist in budgeting and cost control activities.

• Resolve customer enquiries, complaints, and service issues professionally to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and repeat business.

• Coordinate store presentation, cleanliness, and maintenance standards to ensure a safe, organised, and welcoming retail environment.

• Liaise with suppliers, service providers, and senior management regarding stock supply, operational requirements, and business performance improvements.

• Analyse sales trends, customer demand, and operational performance data to support decision-making and improve overall store efficiency.

Skills, experience and education required

•	Diploma or higher qualification in Retail Management, Business Administration or related field.
•	Minimum 1 year full-time relevant experience as a Retail Supervisor or Retail Manager.
•	Strong leadership and staff management skills.
•	Inventory and purchasing management experience.
•	Financial and sales reporting capability.
•	Customer service excellence.
•	Knowledge of food safety and WHS compliance.
•	Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Interested in the role? Apply for the role if you think you meet the criteria, and we’ll get in contact with you shortly. Only eligible candidates will be contacted.
